checks.label: Rendered PDF exists and is non-empty
All source content appears in the PDF

'1 Introduction'/'2 Persons covered by the Internal Rules' numbered — these two headings carried no numPr at all (unlike every other Heading 1 in the document), so the TOC's own '1'/'2' had to be restored as literal text
Each Part's own sub-headings restart their decimal numbering at 1 (separate numId per Part, invisible to the extractor) — Part 1 runs 1-9, Part 2 runs 1-3, Part 3 runs 1-7

Lettered ((a)/(b)/...) and roman ((i)/(ii)/...) list items across the document are reconstructed from their numId/numFmt (lowerLetter/lowerRoman, invisible to the extractor as direct numId on 'List Paragraph' with no literal marker) — a distinct blind spot from a bare bullet list, which needs no reconstruction

The Board of Directors / Executive Management physical signature tables and their '[Signature page ...]' bracket fragments are dropped (No board signatures page convention), keeping the short attribution sentence — note 'Executive Management' as a defined term/role legitimately recurs throughout the body text, so the absent-check targets the signature blocks' own name/title text instead

Schedule 3.3's Power of Attorney Date/Name/Title/Signature fill-in lines are kept as-is — a functional form for the Reporting Person to sign, not a board-approval artifact, so the "no board signatures" convention does not apply to it

The PDMR notification form table's two footnotes (one with a custom mark restarting the table's own count at "1" rather than continuing the document's running footnote count, one auto-numbered "3") render as small notes after the table with the correct marker, not duplicated/mis-numbered

Two footnotes attached to regular body paragraphs (not table cells) — "a dependent child" and the transactions list's lead-in sentence — render inline at the exact position of the reference, not silently dropped or appended at the wrong spot

Appendix A's Definitions glossary table has no artificial header band on its first entry — none of its 22 terms are bold-styled (unlike other policies' glossaries), so the existing bold-based header heuristic needed a shape-based fallback
Appendix B's Inside Information definition and circumstances list are present

Owner left blank (never stated in the source) and approver set to Board of Directors, matching the document's own "Approved by the Board of Directors on 19 May 2026" sentence — the approver/owner card itself only renders on the approval variant's back cover (not checked here, see the "metadata" self-review check), so this assertion checks the body's own attribution sentence instead
